Recall per attack

Every N7 attack cell of the report (3335 cells: DETECTS 91, PARTIAL 119, BLIND 1748, INSUFFICIENT_N 723, NA_BLIND_BY_CONSTRUCTION 640, NOT_RUN 14). Recall is the share of tampered sessions flagged; "honest" is the flag rate of the same sessions untampered; ADR is Track A's attributable detection rate. Execution-path attacks model a compromised tool path; record-editing attacks model someone editing a finished log (DESIGN.md §5.4). All tampering is synthetic. These are Track A probe numbers: the verifier inherits one only after a parity test reproduces it (DESIGN.md DA15).

The kept checks in their claimed units

Every cell

Each row is the cell cells."<unit>|<split>|<detector>|<attack>|<param>" of the file in the last column. Rows with a blue edge are a kept check in its claimed unit. Detector → verifier check: N2 → inline_output_accounting, P1_FLOOR → latency_floor, R1_BRACKET → id_bracket, R4_DUAL → dual_render_recount, R5_LEDGER → ledger_tally.
